{{Quote|Staff-like object created by an unknown ancient Sith. Reportedly imbued with numerous fantastical and damaging abilities. Rumors of object's sentience remain uninvestigated.|Description of the Darkstaff|<ref name="Star Wars: The Old Republic: Rise of the Hutt Cartel">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Rise of the Hutt Cartel]]''</ref>}}
An '''individual''' was a member of the [[Sith/Legends|Sith Order]] who lived thousands of [[Standard year/Legends|years]] before the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. At some point, the individual created the [[Darkstaff]], a dangerous [[Sith artifact/Legends|Sith artifact]] that the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Darth Rivan]] later speculated was the result of an experiment that had gone wrong. The Sith individual regretted creating the staff and was eventually [[Death/Legends|killed]] by the artifact.
